applicability: Applies to integer ranges with nonnegative lo, hi >= lo, bases at least 2, and range size at most 2,000,000. It does not support negative integers, non-integer parameters, or very large ranges. The result is the maximum qualifying integer in the half-open interval [lo, hi), or the provided sentinel if none qualifies.
description: Searches integers n in [lo, hi) and computes the digit sum of n in base_a and base_b by repeated division. Tracks the largest n whose two digit sums are equal and returns it as a string, or none_sentinel if no such n exists. Inputs are validated for integer types, base >= 2, nonnegative lo, hi >= lo, and a bounded range size. The main uncertainty is the intended treatment of 0 and whether the range should be inclusive of hi; this implementation uses [lo, hi) and allows 0.
